tools.name: testlens_mutate
tools.description: Mutation-test Python code: submit the module code and unittest test cases; TestLens generates small mutants (flipped comparisons, swapped operators, inverted booleans), runs the tests against each and reports the mutation score plus every SURVIVOR - behaviour the tests do not check. Free, no key.

tools.description: Check the TestLens API is up. Takes no arguments.
